content: राक्षस {%a.%} (-सी|{%f.%}) [रक्षस इदम् अण्] Belonging to or like an evil spirit, demoniacal, partaking of a demonʼs nature; मुनयो राक्षसीमाहुर्वाचमुन्मत्तदृप्तयोः <ls>U. 5. 30</ls>; ततस्तद्राक्षसं सैन्यम् <ls>Rām. 3. 22. 17</ls>; राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः <ls>Bg. 9. 12</ls>. .{@-सः@} .²1 A demon, an evil spirit, a goblin, fiend, imp. .²2 One of the eight forms of marriage in Hindu Law, in which a girl is forcibly seized and carried away after the defeat or destruction of her relatives in battle; हत्वा छित्त्वा च भित्त्वा च क्रोशन्तीं रुदतीं गृहात् . प्रसह्य कन्याहरणं राक्षसो विधिरुच्यते .. <ls>Ms. 3. 33</ls>; राक्षसो युद्धहरणात् <ls>Y. 1. 61</ls>. (Kṛṣṇa carried away Rukmīṇī in this manner.) .²3 One of the astronomical {%Yogas%}. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a minister of Nanda, an important character in the Mudrārākṣasa. .²5 A king of the Rākṣasas. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of the 30th Muhūrta. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a संवत्सर. .{@-सी@} .²1 A female demon. .²2 Laṅkā or Ceylon. .²3 Night. .²4 A larger tooth, tusk.
